paragraphs: The CLC 200 sits within the CL203 generation, a short production run from 2008 to 2011. It uses the M271 engine, a 1.8-litre supercharged four-cylinder petrol unit. This engine is a key part of the CLC-Class range and is shared with other models of its era, known for its supercharged delivery.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every CLC 200 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the CLC 200 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The CLC 200 uses a single engine family (M271) across its entire production run, meaning compatibility is straightforward compared to multi-engine models. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (M271) via registration or VIN - Your generation (CL203) - Drivetrain and ancillary specification - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build
